name: kubernetes-mcp
description: A read-only Kubernetes cluster inspection tool using Model Context Protocol.

tools.name: get_cluster_status
tools.description: Get overall cluster status including nodes and namespaces.

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: List all nodes with their status, capacity, and allocatable resources.

tools.name: list_namespaces
tools.description: List all namespaces with their status and age.

tools.name: list_pods
tools.description: List pods, optionally filtered by namespace.

tools.name: list_deployments
tools.description: List deployments, optionally filtered by namespace.

tools.name: list_statefulsets
tools.description: List stateful sets, optionally filtered by namespace.

tools.name: list_daemonsets
tools.description: List daemon sets, optionally filtered by namespace.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs, optionally filtered by namespace.

tools.name: list_cronjobs
tools.description: List cron jobs, optionally filtered by namespace.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List recent events, optionally filtered by namespace.
